_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score sits near Complacency band on a flat leg; coil base rate favors HOLD until dvol/ETF flows or F&G break the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD to Complacency; narrative silent on cycle phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, dvol near median, BTC range-bound, no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: dvol expands as F&G breaks under 40 with dead ETF flows (down), or 30d momentum flips up with ETF recovery (up)
